both GRMS are acceptable for estimating DML rates for soybeans at 18 % moisture content and 30°C.
the S-GRMS is more precise and reliable to estimate vDML and DML for soybeans than the D-GRMS.

The main takeaway from our work is that
D-GRMS and S-GRMS can be used to estimate vDML for soybeans at 18 % moisture content and 30°C, but the coefficient of variation for D-GRMs is greater than S-GRMS.
